description: This source file defines a PushRegistrationManager actor responsible for managing push notification registration payloads for direct and relay transports. It includes related data structures for payloads and identities, handles encoding, and manages relay registration state.

classes.name: PushRegistrationManager
classes.description: An actor that manages push registration payload creation and relay registration logic.

classes.name: PushRelayGatewayIdentity
classes.description: A struct representing the identity of a relay gateway with device ID and public key.

methods.name: makeGatewayRegistrationPayload
methods.description: Creates a registration payload string based on the specified APNs token, topic, and optional gateway identity, handling direct or relay transport modes.

methods.name: makeRelayPayload
methods.description: Generates a relay registration payload for relay transport, including interaction with relay client and state management.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a relay handle is expired based on its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a string and returns it in hexadecimal format.

methods.name: normalizeTokenSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes an optional token suffix string by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes a payload as a JSON string for transmission.
